title: Di Cosmo 2021 looming versus flat PPS
citation: Di Cosmo, G., Costantini, M., Spadone, S., Pizzella, V., Della Penna, S., Marzetti, L., & Ferri, F. (2021). Phase-coupling of neural oscillations contributes to individual differences in peripersonal space. Neuropsychologia, 156, 107823.
notes: Inspection of the behavioral looming/flat PPS assessment and the paired resting-state MEG measurement. The behavioral source sounds, calibrated electrical target, response box and external MEG/MRI setup remain required.

study_inventory.scope: Behavioral PPS, resting-state MEG and structural MRI on separate days in the same recruited cohort.

auditory_stimulus.apparatus: Two loudspeakers, the proximal speaker 5 cm from the hand and the other 100 cm farther longitudinally.
auditory_stimulus.looming_intensity_description: Exponential intensity function used to estimate apparent distance.

trial_schedule.d0: Tactile target during silence 700 ms before either sound condition begins.
trial_schedule.order: Randomize combinations and intermix catch trials.

response.participant_position: Seated and blindfolded, right palm supported on a table.
response.target: Speeded press on Cedrus RB-834 with left index finger to right index-finger stimulation.

behavioral_analysis.trial_data: Log-transform tactile reaction times and average by participant, sound condition and delay.
behavioral_analysis.anova: Within-participant sound-by-delay repeated measures ANOVA with Bonferroni follow-ups.
behavioral_analysis.sigmoid: Fit D1–D5 separately by participant and sound, with asymptotes fixed to the observed extrema and two estimated parameters (central point and width). The exact fitting scale is unresolved.

resting_meg.head_localization: Five coils, 3Space Fastrak fiducial digitization, localization after each recording.
resting_meg.processing: Semi-automatic ICA in Curry 6.0; participant T1-based one-shell inner skull BEM and weighted minimum-norm reconstruction, 4 mm grid, three source orientations per voxel.
resting_meg.connectivity: Seed-to-voxel Multivariate Interaction Measure by band, with Pearson correlation to the behavioral looming sigmoid midpoint.

structural_mri.scope: Individual anatomical coregistration and forward model for MEG.

reference_parameters.preview_scope: Source-listed trial timing and acquisition parameters are available for inspection. No playback file, electric stimulation or scanner control is bundled.
implementation_gaps: Original looming and flat sound source files, gain coefficients, file duration and delivered audio calibration are unavailable.
The behavioral scheduler requires a silent negative-SOA lead-in, exact electrical target timing and calibrated response capture.
Resting MEG and T1 MRI require external acquisition systems and a validated connectivity pipeline. The exact spectral windowing, fit options, and acquisition-to-analysis data are unavailable.
